predict: GenKI is a novel framework designed to enhance open-domain question answering (OpenQA) by integrating knowledge and enabling controllable generation in large language models. It is proposed to overcome the limitations of models that rely on search engines to gather knowledge, and instead, leverages the entire knowledge base more effectively. GenKI has demonstrated superior performance compared to baseline models in various datasets, including TriviaQA, MSMARCO, and CMRC, with improvements of 3.3%, 0.8%, and 4.9%, respectively. The code for GenKI is available on GitHub at https://github.com/USTCStarTeam/GenKI.
